summary: 808 bass: a long TR-808 kick played as notes on the Nano sampler (booming sub, decays over ~3 s)
body: The trap and drill bass: the TR-808's long kick (BD0010, 3 s) sounds at about 50 Hz, G1 (MIDI 31) 35 cents sharp, so root_key 31, tune -35 plays it in tune. Play roots in the key between E1 and C2 (MIDI 28–36), on and around the kick, with long notes and gaps; it's the loudest thing in the mix.
Apply makes the track with no notes; make_sampler does the same with notes in one edit (better: the part isn't silent between edits).
